results.label: aov_no_crypto
results.verdict: RETRACTED — was: ADMIT  (+11.25%)  +11.25% improvement, p=4.615e-07, n=5/5 — clears both significance and effect size

retracted.reason: RETRACTED 2026-11-04. Gated against a baseline measured 2h50m earlier (2026-11-03T19:37 local), under a different set of resident processes and a different machine state. The comparison described two different machine states rather than two configurations, so the effect it reports is not the effect of the AOV change. No statistical gate could have caught it: Welch's t-test on two independent series attributes the drift to the candidate, which is what 'independent' means. Re-measured 2026-11-04 with both arms alternately in one session (harness/levers.py, aov_variant lever, the beauty_only variant, which is the stronger of the two AOV reductions): +9.19% (p=8.6e-05). The no_crypto variant was not re-measured on 2026-11-04, so it has no replacement figure of its own; the measured AOV win on this workload is real but smaller than this pairing reported.
retracted.original_verdict: ADMIT  (+11.25%)  +11.25% improvement, p=4.615e-07, n=5/5 — clears both significance and effect size
retracted.replacement_verdict: DENY (+0.77%), paired, n=5/5, baseline drift +0.31%, zero contention events - the no_crypto variant is NOT a win on this workload

reason_corrected.reason: SUPERSEDES the 2026-11-04 16:07 figure (+0.85%, drift +1.59%). That measurement was taken while the card was contended - the drift gate recorded +1.59% and the per-rep contention check did not exist yet, so a WSL benchmark holding the card was invisible to it. Re-measured 2026-11-04 at 22:19 on a card verified idle by process identity (the WSL competitor was waited out and named), with both arms alternately in one session: DENY, +0.77% (paired, n=5/5, baseline drift +0.31%, cv 0.72%, zero contention events, ssim guardrail baseline 0.9966 vs candidate 0.9952). The conclusion is unchanged and now rests on a clean series: dropping the cryptomatte AOV is worth nothing here. The +11.25% this verdict reported was drift between sessions, not the effect of the change. The two AOV reductions are NOT equivalent - beauty_only IS a real win (+9.19%, p=8.6e-05) because it removes all the extra passes, while no_crypto alone is worth nothing.
